quest.title: As Though Surrounded by Thunder
quest.description: The truth behind the doppelgangers and nightmares has been revealed. The actions of the past send ripples through fate, and the events of today blur the line between dreams and reality.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.num: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival: Final Night
chapter.title: As Though Surrounded by Thunder

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'm thinkin' we spice up the final stage with a "Kaboom King"... designed after the one and oni Arataki Itto! I mean, c'mon, how epic are these horns!?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Great idea, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Great idea, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Great idea, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Something tells Paimon this group is about to be as useless as the one you had before...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Don't worry about hurting any feelings, Mr. Thoma. Just let me know if someone's being a nuisance, and I'll knock some sense into them.

dialogues.speaker: "Shousei"
dialogues.text: Hornless oni... is as scary as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, it's fine. As long as Itto's okay with the Kaboom King being defeated by a harpastum in the end.

talks.objective: Talk to Miko and the others

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: ...I assembled all the key information into booklets, Lady Guuji, and the incantation for the ritual has been distributed along with them.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Remarkably efficient, Ayato. How are things with the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: We have adjusted our defensive efforts in response to the Nightmare Fragment. Now that we no longer need to worry about the doppelgangers, we can be much more efficient.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're all here!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Ah, and with your arrival, we can be even more confident in the strength of our defenses.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #Nevertheless, we must remain vigilant. We all must do our part to give {NICKNAME} and the Shogun the best chance against this enemy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's a relief to have you all in our corner!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, where's Ayaka?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Hehe... With the festival preparations complete, we have everything covered over here. Ayaka is currently helping those in need, you could say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those in need?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Most of the game development teams are short on manpower, so Ayaka and a few others are helping them out.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I'm sure you'll run into her as you walk around. Oh, and just a reminder — you need to select the best game later tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Most importantly, don't forget to enjoy yourself! We need this event to be as "joyful" as possible if we want the plan to work.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, I almost forgot about that...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Once you're done experiencing the festival, you should check in with Ei.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An epic quest for fried tofu... It's "A Little Fox's Daydream"!

dialogues.speaker: Gyoubu Koban & Swordfish II
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Gyoubu Koban & Swordfish II
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Gyoubu Koban & Swordfish II
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Miss Mizuki, that means our collaboration can—

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: *snore*... So full...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: ...Can wait until you're fully rested.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The winning team will take home a sum of prize money courtesy of the Yashiro Commission, along with the Tanuki Game Award.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Hm, don't you think this puzzle is a bit too complicated? If we make this small adjustment... it'd be a lot easier to understand, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Y—You're right! I never thought about it that way...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Nice one, Ayaka! I knew you'd be a great addition to the team!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! You two did all the hard work! You made it easy for me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh... When did you get here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just now! Seems like you're a natural, Ayaka! A real game developer at heart, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You talked about wanting to create a game the day before yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh... You remember that. Well, brother had everything covered. So, I asked Yoimiya if she could use a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'm just glad I didn't turn out to be an inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: An inconvenience? We were in such a jam! You saved us!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: In a jam... because jam is sticky, and we got stuck!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Not that kind of jam... But, it doesn't matter. We just need to get this done.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Lady Guuji told me about the upcoming battle. As I understand it, this is an extremely dangerous endeavor, and the rest of us can only help from the sidelines...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Our thoughts and prayers are with you... Be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ohoho, Thoma, my bro! Heard you're in a bind! The "Almighty Arataki Unbeatable and Unmatched Game Dev Team" is here to help!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...I'm not sure how "helpful" most of them will turn out to be, but I, at least, am a licensed game designer.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'm... so sorry everyone. I was so focused on this game, I didn't notice Kinkaku and the others at all...

dialogues.speaker: "Shousei"
dialogues.text: Not your fault! Bake-danuki are powerful! Even Shousei couldn't smell them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we didn't notice anything either.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}... Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Don't sweat the small stuff! I'm sure all Hitotsume Kozou and those little fellas want... is for you to honor their last wishes and finish what you set out to do!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Um... That was beautiful, boss. But, "last wishes" are used for people who are, y'know... dead.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Dead? As in the big sleep? The final curtain? The last hurrah? ...Genta, you copied down the wrong thing!

dialogues.speaker: "Shousei"
dialogues.text: Long-horned oni is stupid... Stupid oni really help make game?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Heh... We'll see. But, as you said, I'll try my best to, um... finish what we started.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, where are the real Hitotsume Kozou and his friends? And what about Tetsunosuke and the others?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: After the three passed out, the bake-danuki hid them in their home to keep them safe... Even under the influence of a Nightmare Fragment, bake-danuki are kind at heart.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: As for Tetsunosuke and the others... They're in charge of setting up the ritual as punishment for causing all that panic — something about showing them what it's really like to "work through the night"...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like Miko's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hehe, once you deal with the crisis, I think I'll get the whole gang together — Hitotsume Kozou, Youko, Kappa...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Plus, Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke, too... We can all play "Akitsu Harpastum" to our heart's content!

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Ah, captain! Swordfish II, salute!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, it's been a while...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I'll say! The squad was a little reluctant to help at first... But, telling them you were the festival representative had them moving faster than an actual swordfish!

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: ...To be honest, some Watatsumi Islanders aren't too concerned about the festival, or the safety of Narukami Island.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: ...But, if they knew it was for the captain of Swordfish II, I'm confident everyone would be here in a heartbeat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not sure I deserve that level of loyalty...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #I doubt you have a choice at this point, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Not even the words of a Divine Priestess are enough to convince the people of Watatsumi and Narukami Islands to let go of the past.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It takes time, communication... and, most importantly, the help of very special people.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Your representation at this festival, and my collaboration with Mizuki will serve as bridges between Watatsumi Island and the outside world.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Huh, I never considered that angle... You possess wisdom beyond your years, Kokomi — on par with a certain other shrine maiden I know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mizuki! Uh... Did you get any sleep at all?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I'm fine. Sometimes, you need to push past your mental limits to unleash your full potential... I've seen that many times in my line of work.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I will. The good news is, the ritual is all set. That means the festival can proceed, and we can focus on realizing our vision.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: As for the more pressing matter, once the Nightmare Fragment appears, we will begin the ritual. But, it needs time to take effect.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: You and the Shogun are the only ones who can subdue the enemy until then... Do you remember what I told you yesterday, before you left for Aisa Bathhouse?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Humans, youkai, and archons bear the same capacity for emotion and are, naturally, susceptible to the same mental turmoil.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: It's very possible that someone who appears strong on the outside has learned to compartmentalize their negative emotions... And that is far from healthy.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Good. I trust you won't let the Shogun shoulder this alone... not anymore.

choices.text: Get a good night's sleep once this is all over.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm set.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Then, come meditate with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem... unsettled.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...Since leaving the Plane of Euthymia, I seem to experience this feeling more and more, whether in the markets of Inazuma or before the Sacred Sakura...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I seem to have a hand in a lot of those... I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: No, it may not be a bad thing. In the Plane of Euthymia, I could not perceive the consequences of my choices, but that did not preclude their impact.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It is only natural that I would feel their effect one day. Even a god cannot sever the link between cause and effect.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I have come to realize that isolating oneself from all engagement... is no way to reach a true state of "euthymia."

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I will not unleash Musou no Hitotachi this time. I can only support you in the battle ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: #Using illusion against illusion, dream against nightmare... The ultimate success of this plan comes down to you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This is a last-minute plan, we don't exactly know what we're about to face, and it could all fall through at a moment's notice... But, one thing is for sure.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...This time, you will not face her alone.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Did... Did we do it...?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Phew, just in time...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: And, it's done...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Right on! Big dubs for the team!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: The Arataki Gang rules!

dialogues.speaker: Nightmare Fragments
dialogues.text: Heh...!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wh—What in the...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Don't panic! Just follow the plan!

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: #Prepare yourself, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Already done.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Alright, follow me!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: In addition, our special guest has the honor of announcing a "special award." Shogun, if you could...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...This "special award" recognizes the team with the "most immersive game"...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: And that goes to the creators of the horror game, "The Doppelganger Incident" — Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke.

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Asari
dialogues.text: Oh, so it was a horror game all along! I really thought I'd seen a ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Komura
dialogues.text: Wow, that takes "immersive" to a whole new level... Bake-danuki are something else!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Ah, smart idea... Now, people have no reason to fear the youkai.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I don't think the Shogun and Lady Guuji want the youkai to fear humans, either.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I present you this award in the name of the Narukami Ogosho, and I promise you this — no human shall infringe on your peace without cause.

dialogues.speaker: Ginkaku
dialogues.text: Shogun... is the best!

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku & Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Shogun is the best!

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku & Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Shogun is the best!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the Shogunate's development plan...?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Heh, the whole purpose of the investigation was to avoid disturbing youkai territory.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Besides, the world is a big place. Humans, youkai... There's more than enough room for all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Alright! {NICKNAME}'s got the hard stuff covered, so let's give this our all!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: How did you sleep last night, Sayu? Do you need a break?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think I can push through, just this once... I'm sure I'll still get taller!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Great Mujina Youkai... Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: God of Thunder, heed our call.

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Shatter the night, unmask it all!

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Shatter the night, unmask it all!

dialogues.speaker: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, and Tetsunosuke
dialogues.text: Shatter the night, unmask it all!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: With your might, let illusions fall.

talks.objective: Talk to Miko and the others

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Night falls, the games are complete, and the Mikawa Flower Festival officially begins...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: ...For many of us, I'm sure the last few days have seen unforgettable levels of stress and fatigue...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: But, for now, I hope we can put the past behind us and enjoy a night of pure, unadulterated fun.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Now, before we kick things off... our representative will announce the award for "best game."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The award for "best game" goes to...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Oh, I wanted to ask... Do you know what this strip of paper is for?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Oh, Miko wrote that. She can explain it better than me... Why don't you ask her?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I... I think I'll ask someone else!

dialogues.speaker: "Gyoubu Koban"
dialogues.text: Big dog... is afraid?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Let's see... "God of Thunder, heed our call"...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Before battle, it is imperative to calm the mind. If you have unfinished business, see to that now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mujina body doubles to the rescue... It's "Bunshin Phantasm"!

dialogues.speaker: Kichiboushi & Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Kichiboushi & Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: W—We won? I'm not dreaming, am I? This is real?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's real, alright. See what's possible when you set your mind to something, Sayu?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Endless fun with harpastum... It's "Akitsu Harpastum"!

dialogues.speaker: Shousei & The Arataki Gang
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Shousei & The Arataki Gang
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Shousei & The Arataki Gang
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Shousei & The Arataki Gang
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Shousei & The Arataki Gang
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I wish Hitotsume Kozou and the other were here. What I'd give to see the look on their faces...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Except... you wouldn't be able to see their expressions at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be right there.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: As you wish... Take in the sights for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! It's finally time for the festival! Hopefully, everything goes okay... Do you think everyone completed their games? Let's go check it out!
